module.title: Days 1–10 | Competition Mastery Module
module.description: Production candidate: authored topic-driven India GK Championship curriculum.

lessons.title: Constitutional framework
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of constitutional framework and apply it accurately to unfamiliar questions.
lessons.core_teaching_content: India-focused championship questions require connected knowledge of constitutional ideas, geography, history, economy, science, environment and culture. Avoid mixing institutions, dates and constitutional roles. Build timelines and maps, then connect events to causes and consequences. When an option contains a familiar fact, verify that it answers the exact question. Precision matters because distractors often combine a correct fact with an incorrect relationship. In this lesson, focus specifically on constitutional framework. Identify the defining concepts, the distinctions that commonly cause mistakes, and the evidence or procedure needed to justify an answer. Practise moving from recognition to application: first identify what the question is testing, then select a method, perform the reasoning carefully, and verify the result against the wording and constraints. Keep an error log that records the misconception or decision error, not just the correct answer.
examples: A India GK Championship question on constitutional framework should be solved by identifying the key clue, applying the relevant principle, and checking the option against all stated conditions.
Create a new constitutional framework scenario with one tempting distractor. Explain why the correct response is supported and why the distractor fails.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused India GK Championship activity on constitutional framework. Build a small table, diagram, worked example, speaking sample, writing sample or practice set as appropriate to the subject, then explain the reasoning behind the result.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on constitutional framework: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent justification on the third. Ask the learner to identify the exact clue, rule or evidence used before confirming the answer.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar questions on constitutional framework without viewing the answer.
Create one new example and solve it using the lesson method.
Review one distractor or error and explain why it is wrong.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item India GK Championship checkpoint focused on constitutional framework. Target at least six correct and justify every uncertain response.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished India GK Championship task demonstrating constitutional framework and record the reasoning, evidence or performance criteria used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach the learner toward evidence-based reasoning and precise terminology. Ask for the method before giving correction, and turn each error into a reusable rule or practice target. This lesson remains suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one mistake pattern and one concrete action for improving constitutional framework in the next practice session.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
